sentences.original_text: Welcome to the Voice of America’s News Words.
sentences.translated_text: 歡迎收看美國之音的「新聞單字」。

sentences.original_text: A museum in Miami, Florida specializes in works of art that stretch the imagination.
sentences.translated_text: 佛羅里達州邁阿密的一間博物館，專門展出挑戰想像力的藝術作品。

sentences.original_text: The Miami Paradox Museum is one of several paradox museums across the world.
sentences.translated_text: 邁阿密悖論博物館是全球幾間悖論博物館之一。

sentences.original_text: More than 70 of its displays produce optical illusions worthy of a photograph.
sentences.translated_text: 館內超過 70 件展品會產生值得拍照留念的視覺錯覺。

sentences.original_text: The museum explains the math and science behind each illusion.
sentences.translated_text: 博物館會說明每一種錯覺背後的數學與科學原理。

sentences.original_text: An illusion is anything that is false or not real but that seems to be true or real.
sentences.translated_text: Illusion 指的是任何虛假、不真實，卻看起來像真的一樣的事物。

sentences.original_text: An optical illusion tricks your eyes to make you think you see something that is not present or that looks different in reality.
sentences.translated_text: 視覺錯覺會欺騙你的眼睛，讓你以為看到了不存在的東西，或是看到與實際不同的樣子。
